description: This file defines a template class 'BaseContainerAdministrator' which manages a collection of container objects, providing methods for container retrieval, insertion, removal, and synchronization. It is part of the 'WPEFramework::ProcessContainers' namespace and includes external dependencies related to process container management.

classes.name: BaseContainerAdministrator
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of container objects with thread-safe access, providing methods for container management and iteration.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the container IDs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, increasing its reference count.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container from the collection, called during container destruction.

methods.name: InternalLock
methods.description: Locks the internal mutex for thread-safe operations.

methods.name: InsertContainer
methods.description: Inserts a container into the collection; must be called with the lock held.
